questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (e.g., at 00:09), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.
The rightmost pen is placed diagonally/tilted, while the other two are vertical. Although caps are down for all, they are not strictly aligned in the same direction/orientation on the board.
All three pens have translucent grey barrels and black caps/ends. They appear to be the same model and color.
All pens have a black cap/end visible. None show a bare writing tip. They appear to be of equal length.
The board moves steadily from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The board carries three identical pens, all capped and facing generally the same way (caps down). The slight tilt of the rightmost pen is considered a minor placement variation or perspective issue rather than a 'wrong orientation' anomaly (which is defined as flipped/opposite way). Motion is smooth.

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
